in_sanskrit.name: Diku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Diku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Diku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhaneshwari', which means 'Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity'. This name is often used in Hindu tradition for a baby girl, as it is believed to bring wealth and prosperity to the family.
